name: After § 31
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Ukraine
part_text: 31a. Recalls that, for more than 20 years, the EU has been supporting Ukraine in its reform agenda; deplores the grand corruption and state capture that are still endemic in Ukraine and the ineffectiveness of EU reform assistance in fighting grand corruption; calls for the EU to carry out an assessment of the effectiveness of EU funding provided to Ukraine and to link funding more closely to results in the fight against corruption and, if necessary, to withdraw it;
